name: Nerve
author: Erin Carter
description: A living neural culture: dim nuclei seeded blue-noise across a near-black dish. Excitation waves start at hash-random cells and roll node-to-node as curved wavefronts of point-flashes, each fired cell blooming in a position-keyed hue then slumping into a darker-than-rest refractory shadow. No lines are ever drawn — the wiring is invisible and the light hops cell to cell.

params.label: Fire rate
params.effect: How often new excitation waves start; min leaves long quiet spells between cascades, max keeps several wavefronts crossing the dish at once.

params.label: Spread speed
params.effect: Propagation rate of the cell-to-cell cascade; min takes most of a minute to cross the frame, max a few seconds.

params.label: Cell spacing
params.effect: Characteristic spacing of the cell bodies in CSS pixels — small seeds a dense fine-grained culture, large a sparse field of bold nuclei.

params.label: Afterglow
params.effect: How long each fired cell's ember and refractory shadow linger behind the wavefront; 0 snaps cells straight back to rest, 1 leaves long cooling wakes.
